apps.name: Hotels MUSE iPhone
apps.notes: Exact-realism pass: real printed MB 1987 board artwork as textures (board + 8 plot tiles, no procedural painting), buildings corrected against video close-ups (Taj 3 onion domes, Safari gable roof, Le Grand short townhouse, Fujiyama round disc caps on octagonal cylinders, Boomerang vertical window strips, Royal thicker caps + wider entrance block, Waikiki shorter, President 6 window rows, Bank mansard roof), lower camera so buildings read, one-row building layout with grey plinths, display-cutout safe area + BUILD sheet rewrite (48dp gold checkboxes, plain-language permit legend). v1.3 crash fix and v1.4 'Your turn' fix intact; gameplay, rules and deed values unchanged.
